payload.answer: Asymmetric, and currently biased toward the expensive error. The display hardcodes $40/$250, so a project configured at $200 reads as though it were near a much lower ceiling. An operator sees '$12 of $40' and grants more, believing they are topping up a small budget, when the real cap is five times that. The failure is not merely a wrong number -- it is a wrong number in the reassuring direction at exactly the moment money is authorised. The opposite error, denying a run with real headroom, wastes the work already paid for.
